comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Sells protein shakes and sports nutrition foods through retailers, a packaged-food business unlike Peloton's connected fitness hardware and streaming subscriptions.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: B2B payment, telemetry and vending software for machine operators; no consumer fitness hardware or class subscriptions.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Designs and sells UGG, HOKA and Teva footwear and apparel; a footwear brand, not connected fitness equipment or streaming.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Wholesale apparel, outerwear and footwear sourcing and licensing sold to department stores; no fitness equipment or subscriptions.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Nutrition and weight-management products sold through independent distributors, a multi-level marketing model unlike Peloton's direct equipment sales.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Digital publishing and advertising business monetized through ads and affiliate commissions, with no hardware or subscription fitness product.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Franchised physical gym memberships; members use clubs rather than connected home equipment or streaming classes.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Televised and online retail of third-party merchandise; a reseller of consumer goods, not a maker of connected fitness products.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Branded protein bars, shakes and snacks sold through grocery retailers; packaged foods, not fitness equipment or streaming.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Private-label home furnishings and kitchenware sold through stores and websites; a home retailer, not connected fitness.
